items.name: button
items.title: Sakuga Button
items.description: A button that reacts like an anime impact frame: it squashes when pressed, inverts for one frame on release, and a burst goes off behind it with clouds and ドン!. A secondary variant is quieter. One file, no dependencies, defines <sakuga-button>.
items.author: Justin Finkelman
items.docs: Sakuga Button is a plain script that registers a custom element. Load /sakuga-vfx/button.js with a script tag (not a module), then use <sakuga-button>Confirm</sakuga-button> (variant="secondary" for the quiet one). Listen for click; call el.done() when the action worked to land a check on it. More: https://github.com/chenlongapps/sakuga-vfx-i18n/blob/main/button/README.md

items.name: toggle
items.title: Sakuga Toggle
items.description: A spring-driven Canvas 2D switch with inked smears, sloshing liquid, and localized lettering on impact at either end. One file, no dependencies, defines <sakuga-toggle>.
items.author: Justin Finkelman
items.docs: Sakuga Toggle is a plain script that registers a custom element. Load /sakuga-vfx/toggle.js with a script tag (not a module), then use <sakuga-toggle label="Notifications"></sakuga-toggle>. Read el.checked and listen for change. Works in forms with a name. More: https://github.com/chenlongapps/sakuga-vfx-i18n/blob/main/toggle/README.md

items.name: slider
items.title: Sakuga Slider
items.description: A range slider whose thumb stretches and lags on a spring, with cumulus rolling up behind a fast drag and a crescent thrown ahead on release. One file, no dependencies, defines <sakuga-slider>.
items.author: Justin Finkelman
items.docs: Sakuga Slider is a plain script that registers a custom element. Load /sakuga-vfx/slider.js with a script tag (not a module), then use <sakuga-slider value="30" label="Volume"></sakuga-slider>, with min, max, step and unit. Read el.value; it fires input and change. Works in forms with a name. More: https://github.com/chenlongapps/sakuga-vfx-i18n/blob/main/slider/README.md

items.name: radio
items.title: Sakuga Radio
items.description: A radio group whose picked dot springs in with a fan of wedges, two puffs and a hollow ポン. One file, no dependencies, defines <sakuga-radio>.
items.author: Justin Finkelman
items.docs: Sakuga Radio is a plain script that registers a custom element. Load /sakuga-vfx/radio.js with a script tag (not a module), then use <sakuga-radio label="Plan"><option value="a" selected>Option A</option><option value="b">Option B</option></sakuga-radio>. Read el.value and listen for change. Works in forms with a name. More: https://github.com/chenlongapps/sakuga-vfx-i18n/blob/main/radio/README.md

items.name: input
items.title: Sakuga Input
items.description: A text field that kicks up a puff of dust from the caret on every key. One file, no dependencies, defines <sakuga-input>.
items.author: Justin Finkelman
items.docs: Sakuga Input is a plain script that registers a custom element. Load /sakuga-vfx/input.js with a script tag (not a module), then use <sakuga-input label="Name" placeholder="Type something"></sakuga-input>. Read and set el.value; it fires input and change. Works in forms with a name. More: https://github.com/chenlongapps/sakuga-vfx-i18n/blob/main/input/README.md

items.name: tabs
items.title: Sakuga Tabs
items.description: Tabs where the raised tab slides to the one you pick, stretching, and lands with wedges and a puff. One file, no dependencies, defines <sakuga-tabs>.
items.author: Justin Finkelman
items.docs: Sakuga Tabs is a plain script that registers a custom element. Load /sakuga-vfx/tabs.js with a script tag (not a module), then use <sakuga-tabs label="Sections"><option>Home</option><option>Profile</option></sakuga-tabs>. Listen for change (e.detail: index, value, label) and show the panel yourself. More: https://github.com/chenlongapps/sakuga-vfx-i18n/blob/main/tabs/README.md

items.name: progress
items.title: Sakuga Progress
items.description: A loading bar with a storm cloud riding its leading edge, pebbles lifting off the ground and ゴゴゴゴ; at the end a burst, ドン! and a check. One file, no dependencies, defines <sakuga-progress>.
items.author: Justin Finkelman
items.docs: Sakuga Progress is a plain script that registers a custom element. Load /sakuga-vfx/progress.js with a script tag (not a module), then use <sakuga-progress label="Loading"></sakuga-progress>, then el.set(n) with progress from 0 to 1. Listen for sakuga:done (fires once). el.reset() for the next task. More: https://github.com/chenlongapps/sakuga-vfx-i18n/blob/main/progress/README.md

items.author: Justin Finkelman
items.docs: Sakuga Rating is a plain script that registers a custom element. Load /sakuga-vfx/rating.js with a script tag (not a module), then use <sakuga-rating label="Rating"></sakuga-rating>. Read el.value (0 to 5) and listen for change. Works in forms with a name. More: https://github.com/chenlongapps/sakuga-vfx-i18n/blob/main/rating/README.md

items.name: toast
items.title: Sakuga Toast
items.description: A notification that streaks in as a smear, lands in dust with ズザッ, wobbles and leaves by shrinking. One file, no dependencies, defines <sakuga-toast>.
items.author: Justin Finkelman
items.docs: Sakuga Toast is a plain script that registers a custom element. Load /sakuga-vfx/toast.js with a script tag (not a module), then use <sakuga-toast></sakuga-toast> where toasts should appear and call el.show("Saved"). It stays for the duration attribute (2.6 s) or until el.hide(). More: https://github.com/chenlongapps/sakuga-vfx-i18n/blob/main/toast/README.md
